study.question: Can direct click supervision of the existing target-aware history pool improve validation ranking at fixed data passes, without materially increasing inference cost? Supplied references show static AUC 0.6050036145, pooled 0.6102261137, and DIN 0.6133619861 (3,234,051 validation impressions, 159,437 positives). DIN remains weak for user_train_frequency_0_1 (AUC 0.5664034320; 321,587 impressions, 18,684 positives) versus user_train_frequency_100_4294967296 (0.6351457799; 1,004,912 impressions, 33,140 positives). These exploratory slice differences suggest a question, not evidence that gradient starvation or collapse occurred. No failed candidate trajectories exist in the supplied allowed history. Raw tables and execution are host-owned and unavailable locally; the supplied successful reference receipts and matching baseline source provide the starting evidence, not an agent-run reproduction.
study.hypothesis: The primary late-fusion classifier may fit static predictors without making its 16-dimensional attended history easily predictive. A modest auxiliary click BCE on that representation may make it more useful to the unchanged classifier. This is an unverified optimization hypothesis, not a measured gradient or collapse finding. No new behavior, item identity, delayed outcome, teacher, or future feature is assumed.

inherited_components: Local baseline-din complete inference architecture, initialization order, embeddings, attention normalization, recency buckets and output MLP.
Frozen host causal-prefix data construction, split, sample coverage, scorer, optimizer defaults and validation checkpoint selection.
Standard BCE and auxiliary deep supervision; no new scientific contribution is asserted from adding a head alone.
study.proposed_difference: All four standalone modules have byte-identical source and differ only in declared aux_mode. During training, cache the current forward pooled history and target embedding. Optimize unchanged mean primary BCE plus 0.2 * mean auxiliary BCE over nonempty histories; the auxiliary head is Linear(16,32), ReLU, Linear(32,1), adding 577 stored parameters. history mode uses pooled history, detached mode blocks its backbone gradients, permuted mode breaks within-batch label alignment using a private generator, and target mode replaces the auxiliary input with current category+brand. Auxiliary initialization preserves the CPU RNG state and occurs after the reference modules. Inference never calls the auxiliary head; its retained weights slightly increase checkpoint size. No extra forward pass, epoch, optimizer change, class weighting, or new data is introduced. Diagnostics provide only label-free norms, entropy and mean auxiliary probabilities on the authorized 512 rows.
predictions: History auxiliary supervision will improve full validation AUC by at least 0.0003 against detached_aux, with Logloss no worse by more than 0.0001; this practical threshold is not a significance test.

If aligned information, rather than nonspecific regularization, matters, history_aux should beat permuted_aux; if the chosen history path matters beyond target-field supervision, it should beat target_aux. One seed provides preliminary evidence only.

Detached_aux should closely reproduce baseline-din inference and performance under paired host initialization/data order. A material mismatch is an implementation or recipe warning, not positive mechanism evidence.

Exploratory effect modifiers are the host-defined user-frequency and history-length slices, including empty histories. Preserve their bins and counts; empty histories may still change through shared parameters. Slice benefits are not assumed from their lower starting AUC.

With no auxiliary inference execution, measured p95 batch latency should stay within 5% of detached_aux and baseline-din allowing timing noise. The candidate should cost no more than 20% additional training wall time versus detached_aux. Fixed-pass performance and measured cost are distinct; no equal-compute superiority is claimed without a later admissible cost-matched comparison.
falsifiers: No repeatable AUC gain over detached_aux at the practical threshold, or a consequential Logloss degradation, rejects usefulness of this registered setting.
Matching or better performance from permuted_aux weakens label-alignment attribution; matching or better target_aux weakens attribution specifically to history supervision.

Nonfinite loss/logits, stale-forward cache errors, changed sample identities, or failure to reproduce detached reference behavior are execution/integrity failures, not counterevidence to the scientific mechanism.
Norm or entropy changes without controlled ranking gains do not support representation usability. The 512-row label-free diagnostic sample cannot establish predictive information or global collapse.
Exceeding the declared cost thresholds defeats the practical efficiency hypothesis even if AUC improves.
alternative_explanations: General regularization from an additional noisy loss rather than improved history information.
Extra supervised updates to shared target embeddings rather than attention or behavior learning.
Different gradient scale, optimization trajectory or chosen checkpoint rather than an information bottleneck.
Single-seed variation, time drift, repeated-user dependence and multiple exploratory slices.
Intrinsic user-frequency distribution differences or coarse/missing category/brand histories explain weak slices; direct supervision may not repair them.

contrasts.intervention: history_aux: primary BCE plus 0.2 times same-impression click BCE from the attended history vector; auxiliary gradients enter history embeddings and attention.
contrasts.control: detached_aux: identical head, labels and loss, but detach its input. Also compare with supplied baseline-din as an implementation sanity reference.

remaining_confounds: Backward cost differs because detach removes the auxiliary path to the backbone.
History contains shared category/brand embeddings, action and recency; auxiliary effects are not exclusively sequential.

contrasts.decision_if_supported: If history_aux exceeds detached_aux by at least 0.0003 validation AUC, without Logloss worsening by more than 0.0001, investigate repetition and other controls before attributing the gain.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: Retain the null or negative result. If loss is finite and diagnostics nondegenerate, do not call this a mechanism refutation; consider one smaller weight only if repeated evidence and reserved budget justify it.

contrasts.intervention: history_aux uses labels aligned to the current history representation.
contrasts.control: permuted_aux uses a fresh private-RNG uniform permutation of click labels within each batch of nonempty histories; prevalence, head size and loss coefficient are matched.

remaining_confounds: Permutation is across impressions, not users, because user identity is not provided separately; repeated users can preserve some dependence.
Aligned and permuted tasks have different difficulty and gradient magnitudes.
Shuffling approximates a nonspecific regularization control and does not span every general regularizer.
contrasts.decision_if_supported: An aligned advantage over both detached and permuted controls supports the relevance of same-impression supervision, provisionally at seed 42.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: If permuted_aux matches or exceeds history_aux, prefer a nonspecific regularization or optimization explanation and avoid claiming label-specific history learning.

contrasts.intervention: history_aux sends the aligned click objective through the target-aware history pool.
contrasts.control: target_aux sends the same click objective through the sum of current category and brand embeddings, with the same 16-dimensional input and auxiliary head.

remaining_confounds: Target and history representation scales and information content differ.

contrasts.decision_if_supported: A history advantage over the matched target control, permuted control and detached control motivates paired validation repetitions; it supports the chosen auxiliary path rather than a universal history mechanism.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: If target_aux is as good, treat additional target supervision as sufficient; do not attribute an improvement specifically to history representation usability.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: run://r-001 frozen estimated full unit 704.372973 seconds, baseline-din wall 610.819499, train 522.065301, inference 16.013342, peak GPU 654936064 bytes; remaining at entry 86399.644585 seconds, per-trial hard cap 1760.932432 seconds. Budget includes source review, preparation, diagnostics and failed attempts. No training is run in the propose phase.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Initial four full-protocol variants: roughly 2818 seconds at supplied unit estimate, conservatively at most 7044 seconds under four trial caps. Reserve 15000 additional seconds for discriminating follow-ups and failures. All variants have 17,130,852 expected parameters at default dimensions (17,130,275 reference + 577); head/backbone backward cost differs by mode and must be measured, not inferred from parameter count. Review all four outcomes, including failures, before any continuation.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve 22000 seconds for a frozen validation-only comparison suite of four arms and three paired seeds 42/43/44 (12 full trial caps total about 21132 seconds), plus remaining budget for reporting/preparation. Reuse seed-42 receipts only when source/config/input/protocol hashes match and host permits; never automatically duplicate an unknown-state execution. No test feedback or closed archive is authorized. Freeze selected candidate, closest reference, key controls, hashes and commands before assessment. If candidate fails, report the baseline and negative controls faithfully.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Never exceed remaining total seconds or the host trial cap. Do not spend attribution or assessment reserves on routine screening. Stop when no admissible useful experiment fits or integrity fails. Inspect controls before tuning; do not treat one failed setting as mechanism refutation. If paired repeats cannot fit, record omissions and keep conclusions preliminary. Only host-authorized execution can verify numerical behavior, costs and performance.

variants.name: history_aux
variants.note: Aligned click auxiliary loss on the current target-aware history pool; primary reference inference is preserved. Scientific hypothesis, not a verified improvement.

variants.name: detached_aux
variants.note: Identical head and aligned labels, stop auxiliary gradients at pooled history. Capacity/initialization control and reference sanity check; backward cost is lower.

variants.name: permuted_aux
variants.note: Permute labels only in the nonempty-history auxiliary loss; primary labels and inference stay intact. Preserves batch prevalence, not user independence or gradient magnitude.

variants.name: target_aux
variants.note: Same-size auxiliary head and aligned labels, replace input by current category+brand. Tests whether extra target-field supervision suffices; input scale is not matched.
